test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 03 May 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Improve the underlined part of the sentence. Choose 'No improvement' as an answer if the sentence is grammatically correct.

The waiter __giving the diners__ some complimentary mints.
solution:
The correct answer is** 'Option 4' **i.e. **'Gave the diners'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The improved version of the underlined part of the sentence is: **"gave the diners"**
 
• **The sentence** is a simple past tense narrative statement.
 
• Therefore, the verb **"give" **should be in the past tense form **"gave".**
 
• The form **"giving" **is present participle and doesn't fit well in this context without additional information.

Therefore, the **correct sentence** is:* 'The waiter** gave the diners** some complimentary mints.'*
